title: N+1 hides until traffic finds it
subtitle: Loading an order list should not fire one query per order for its line items.
insight: Lazy navigation looks correct in a unit test with three rows and falls over at production scale. Project or Include so EF Core issues one query, not N+1.

panels.label: BEFORE / lazy navigation per order
AFTER / project what you need
